commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+2' Here is a change. Lameck Banda is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce).

83' Great solo effort by Milan Djuric (Verona) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.
82' The ball is crossed into the box and Ondrej Duda (Verona) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone gets a glove on it to thwart him.
82' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

80' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Verona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
77' 2 - 2 The ball is whipped in from the resulting set piece and finds the head of Milan Djuric (Verona) who rises and produces an amazing header into the bottom right corner.
75' Today's match ends for Tomas Suslov who will be replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).

74' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.

74' Lecce slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

65' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) replacing Nikola Krstovic.
64' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Tomas Suslov (Verona) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
64' Substitution. Nicola Sansone leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce).
64' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Ondrej Duda (Verona) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the top of the net, Wladimiro Falcone makes a decent save to stop the effort.
62' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Jordi Mboula and he is replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).

60' Lecce couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
56' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

27' What a chance that is! Nicola Sansone (Lecce) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
27' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' Remi Oudin (Lecce) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
24' The referee gives a yellow card to Lameck Banda (Lecce) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.

21' Lecce are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

17' Lameck Banda (Lecce) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
16' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
15' Fouls committed – 3:3.
13' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) makes a slide tackle, but referee Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
11' What a huge chance for Nicola Sansone (Lecce). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
11' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
11' A cross from Jordi Mboula (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
8' Ondrej Duda (Verona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
7' Ondrej Duda (Verona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
6' Wladimiro Falcone makes a good save! Cyril Ngonge (Verona) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the left side of the goal is saved by the keeper!
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
5' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Federico La Penna stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
3' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
2' Wonderful movement by Lecce. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
